headline: A big lynx and a lost dog
summary: Roosevelt kills a 31-pound lynx after a run of more than an hour. One dog goes into a hole after another lynx and never comes back out. He writes Ethel about the ranch animals, among them a pig named Maude.

headline: A cougar in the spruce
summary: Roosevelt kills a cougar in a spruce tree. He later wrote about hunting mule deer on this trip in The Deer Family, recalling bitterly cold days.
